expected_outcome: Installed hooks protect the control plane, apply modeled policy floors, and reserve policy repair for the repository owner.
observations: Both installed launch modes passed control-plane enforce and advisory scenarios and blocked agent edits when local policy was malformed or remote policy unavailable.
Repository disables cannot suppress policy_integrity, while synthetic explicit check selection remains available.
Ignored repository weakening attempts are visible in fettle config --explain.
Policy changes after session start block Stop and make Assurance Record policy integrity fail.
Review follow-ups prove committed-code detection, complete multi-target fan-out, truthful required-check wiring, protected patch move destinations, and malformed native pre-tool handling.

Stop does not create session-start evidence: after session state was removed and code changed, both launch modes blocked for missing verification; a first Stop in a clean tree allowed with unknown policy integrity.
Review findings R-1 through R-6 were reproduced on 2026-11-17 and corrected with retained red and green evidence under $TMPDIR/phase-hl/hl11/r1 through r6.
Commands that reference the control plane allow only the documented read-only command set; computed or obfuscated paths inside another program remain outside shell-text detection.
Sessions that start and stop without a resolvable commit allow when unchanged, and snapshot- or HEAD-triggered verification names that cause truthfully.
